subject: Request to move demo — new security + procurement attendees
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@atlasplatform.com>
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + 30m demo next week?

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for taking the call last week. Per our discussion, we'd love to run a 30-minute walkthrough of Redwood Inference's hosted offering and show a short latency/cost rundown tailored to your ingestion patterns.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Thu Nov 5, 10:00–10:30
- Thu Nov 5, 14:00–14:30

If one of those works I will send a calendar invite and a short prep pack. Also adding Dev (solutions) and Karthik (platform) on cc for any technical Qs.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
From: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@atlasplatform.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir@atlasplatform.com>, procurement@atlasplatform.com, Ben Jacobs <ben.jacobs@atlasplatform.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + 30m demo next week?

Laura —

Thanks, Thu Nov 5 would work in general, but two quick updates from our side:
1) Our security lead Ben Jacobs asked to join — he also requested the pre-demo security questionnaire to be sent.
2) Procurement would like to attend the tail end to confirm contracting milestones; they asked for a slightly longer slot to cover next steps.

Would you and your team be able to make 45 minutes instead of 30? If so, could we move to Fri Nov 6 morning (PST) — Samir is traveling on Thu and unavailable.

I'll attach the security contact details separately.

—Olivia
Head of Product Ops | Atlas Platform
olivia.turner@atlasplatform.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@atlasplatform.com>
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, procurement@atlasplatform.com, Ben Jacobs <ben.jacobs@atlasplatform.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + 30m demo next week?

Olivia and team —

Totally understood — happy to expand to 45 minutes to cover security and procurement. We're flexible on Fri Nov 6 morning. Proposed new times (PST):
- Fri Nov 6, 09:00–09:45
- Fri Nov 6, 10:30–11:15
- Fri Nov 6, 11:30–12:15

I'll add Dev and Karthik to the session to cover integrations and infra. Dev — can you make any of those? Karthik — can you be on for the architecture/ops Qs?

Couple of things attached for Ben & procurement to scan before the call: a short pre-demo security questionnaire and a draft SOW with seat/bandwidth estimates. We'll keep the first 20 minutes product/demo and the last 25 minutes for security, procurement, and next steps.

Thanks,
Laura
From: dev.patel@redwood.ai <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + 30m demo next week?

Laura —

I can do 09:00–09:45 on Fri Nov 6. Will prepare a quick slide on expected throughput and an infra slide showing routing/fallback policies. Also I'll bring a short list of quantization/latency tradeoffs since procurement has been asking about unit economics.

Karthik?

—Dev
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, dev.patel@redwood.ai, Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@atlasplatform.com>
Cc: procurement@atlasplatform.com, Ben Jacobs <ben.jacobs@atlasplatform.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + 30m demo next week?

All —

09:00–09:45 Fri Nov 6 works for me. I will be remote but can take infra/ops questions and run through deployment topologies (VPC, dedicated GPU pools). If Ben has any items he wants explicitly covered, please share them and I'll slot them into the latter half.

I'll also include a 1-slide diagram of fallback routing and an example autoscale policy tuned for predictable tail latency.

Karthik
Head of Platform Services | Redwood Inference
From: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@atlasplatform.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, dev.patel@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@atlasplatform.com, Ben Jacobs <ben.jacobs@atlasplatform.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Final confirmation: moving demo to Fri 6 09:00 — agenda + attendee list

Thanks everyone, and sorry for the late consolidated note — Samir is traveling and Ben had a couple of calendar conflicts earlier this week. Confirmed: Fri Nov 6, 09:00–09:45 PST.

Attendees (Atlas): Olivia Turner (POps), Samir Rao (Eng lead), Ben Jacobs (Security), Procurement (procurement@atlasplatform.com).
Attendees (Redwood): Laura Bennett, Dev Patel, Karthik Iyer.

Proposed agenda:
1) 09:00–09:20 Product demo + latency/cost highlights
2) 09:20–09:35 Security and network/privilege model (Ben)
3) 09:35–09:45 Procurement and next steps (terms/lead time)

Ben — I attached a short list of questions (pre-demo-security-questions.pdf) and a contact for our compliance team. If anything else comes up, we can adjust on the call.

See you Friday.

—Olivia
